sentences.text: HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA
ORAL JUDGMENT
No representation on appellant's side on call.
2. As per office endorsement, cost of Rs.2,500/- is not deposited.
The appeal was dismissed for non-compliance of office objections.
Thereafter, the appellant filed I.A.No.1/2023 to recall the said order and I.A.No.2/2023 to condone the delay of 40 days in filing the recalling application.
Both the applications were allowed subject to payment of cost of Rs.2,500/- to the Advocates' Clerks Benevolent Trust.
However, said deposit is not made as per office endorsement.
Also there is no representation on appellant's side on call.
3. Thus due to non-compliance of the condition imposed, I.A.No.1/2023 and I.A.No.2/2023 stands dismissed and consequently, the appeal also stands dismissed without costs.
